changes: In /agent/solver.md I added rules to steps 6–10. The main one (rule 7) forbids calling submit until the final code has passed the public examples and a brute-force comparison that checks the objective value, not just feasibility. I also added guidance on edge cases (n=1, M=0, isolated components, forbidden start states) and on matching the exact output format. Failure reports showed submits with zero test runs (lcb-3655) and hidden-test failures from unchecked objectives and edge cases. One trial on lcb-3655 still failed: the agent passed the samples and submitted without the brute-force or timing check, so I made the brute-force step mandatory. That final wording was not re-trialed; validate() reports OK.
